worldcombat.skill.nightmare.summary: Gives an already sleeping opponent nightmares: every so often it takes a share of the target's maximum health and holds it down in sleep so it cannot wake. It only works on a sleeping target, and the drain ignores defence and type; to save the sleeper you must clear the nightmare, or down or drive off the caster.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.0: Cash in a sleep window you or an ally made
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.1: Press steady health loss onto a sleeper
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.2: Force an opponent to spend a cleanse or come protect the sleeper
Curses a sleeping target at a reach of %1$s; every %2$s it takes %3$s of the target's maximum health (each pulse 20%% lighter), ignoring defence and type.
The nightmare lasts %1$s, with %2$s shades and a dream seal of radius %3$s; meanwhile the target is held asleep and only wakes when the nightmare runs out or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.deep.on: Deep dream: each drain ×1.15 and tighter spacing, but total length ×0.8 (fewer pulses), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.deep.off: Long dream: each drain ×0.85, but total length ×1.25 and more pulses.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.growth.0: From level %1$s the shades rise to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.growth.1: From level %1$s the shades are %2$s, each drain %3$s and the reach %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.preference.d: On: each drain ×1.15 and tighter spacing, but total length ×0.8 (fewer pulses), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown — a quick harvest. Off (long dream): each drain ×0.85, but total length ×1.25 and more pulses — a slow grind.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.preference.a: Beyond this distance from a sleeping target the priority drops to 36 and the partner walks into position before cursing (it still casts); larger lets it press in from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to curse.
